name: 20011 · Washington, DC
findings: ZIP 20011 (Washington) has 437 nonprofit organizations. 199 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 154 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20011 (Washington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 20011 (Washington) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 154 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
